caption: A Spearmen block and an Archer block are dragged into one line behind them, and the Spearmen turn about and re-form in place from 10 files into 5 before they march. A hundred and fifty men crossing a tight block to new places crowd, and men far off their places walk past men nearer theirs. The closest two now stay 3.43 wu apart: nearer than the 9 wu two bodies take up, but above the 2.25 wu overlap floor. Before this fix a man the crowd drove on walked on through his neighbour, and two men came within 1.08 wu. A reform hold also keeps its men apart now when every man stands within a file pitch of his place, where two neighbours trading places once crossed within 0.51 wu (the line-membership checkerboard clip).
